description: ITEM 2: Thinking/reasoning-trace ON/OFF toggle in the chat bar (explicit user decision). Add a compact ON/OFF toggle to the composer control row (labeled e.g. '🧠 Thinking'), OFF by default, persisted like the web-search toggle. When ON, the streamed thinking text renders in the assistant message as a COLLAPSIBLE, visually-distinct 'Reasoning' section above the final answer; when OFF, thinking is not requested/shown. Thread an optional `thinking` field through the backend: StreamDelta (native adapter) -> ChatDelta -> a CoreEvent path -> frontend, mirroring the MessageStarted.text additive-field pattern (serde camelCase, default + skip_serializing_if). Provider-aware: only thinking-capable models emit thinking; for others the section never appears and nothing crashes.
steps: BACKEND capture: In crates/providers/src/adapters/native.rs, add an optional reasoning/thinking field to StreamDelta with `#[serde(default)]` and a `#[serde(alias = "reasoning_content", alias = "thinking", alias = "reasoning")]` so the OpenAI-compatible delta shape used by Ollama's /v1 path captures reasoning tokens under whatever key the server emits (Ollama surfaces reasoning as `reasoning_content` on the OpenAI-compat delta when thinking is requested). In parse_stream_chunk, map it into a new `ChatDelta.thinking: Option<String>` field. Update the empty-delta skip check so a delta carrying ONLY thinking is still yielded (not skipped).

In crates/providers/src/contract.rs, add `pub thinking: Option<String>` to ChatDelta with `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]` (mirroring the existing content field attributes). Update the existing ChatDelta serde round-trip test to cover the thinking field and keep `ChatDelta::default()` behavior. Also add an optional request-side signal: extend the outbound body so that when thinking is requested the Ollama/native request carries the appropriate param (Ollama accepts `think: true`; for the OpenAI-compat path splice it via the existing `extra` passthrough in NativeAdapter::body). Gate this on a request flag - see next step.

Thread the request-side toggle: add a way for the pipeline/adapter to know thinking was requested. Simplest correct approach: add an optional field to ChatRequest (e.g. `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if)] pub think: bool` or reuse `extra`) that set_message/send path sets when the toggle is ON, and have NativeAdapter::body splice `think`/reasoning-enable into the outbound body only when set. Keep it additive and default-off so non-thinking paths are byte-identical to today. If wiring the request flag end-to-end balloons, implement the CAPTURE side fully (parse + thread + display) and NOTE the request-param deferral - many thinking models emit reasoning by default, so capture-only still demonstrates the feature.

EVENT path: In crates/orchestrator-core/src/events.rs add a MessageThinkingDelta variant (conversation_id, message_id, delta) OR add an optional `thinking` field to MessageDelta - choose the additive option that least disturbs existing consumers; a separate MessageThinkingDelta variant is cleaner (keeps the content delta path byte-identical). Use rename_all camelCase. Update the exhaustive match in the no_core_event_variant_carries_secret_material test and the events serde tests to include the new variant.

In crates/orchestrator-core/src/pipeline.rs::stream_turn, when a ChatDelta carries `thinking`, emit the new thinking event (accumulate into the outcome if needed for persistence, but at minimum stream it). Do NOT break the existing content delta emission. Keep thinking out of the persisted final answer text unless the existing model design wants it stored; prefer emitting it as a live event only and NOT persisting into the assistant message content (so history stays answer-only) - note this decision in findings.

FRONTEND types/events: In frontend/src/types/index.ts add the new CoreEvent variant (messageThinkingDelta) to the union, and add an optional `thinking?: string` accumulator field to the Message type (or a parallel per-message reasoning buffer in the store). In frontend/src/state/conversations.ts applyCoreEvent, handle the new event by appending to the message's thinking buffer (guarded on active conversation like messageDelta). Initialize any new store/message field in EVERY setState reset and placeholderMessage.

FRONTEND toggle: In frontend/src/features/chat/Composer.tsx add a compact ON/OFF toggle in the control row next to the web-search toggle, using the SAME pattern (button with aria-pressed, aria-label 'Toggle reasoning trace' / title 'Thinking: on'/'off', data-active). Back it with a store flag `thinkingEnabled` + `setThinkingEnabled` in conversations.ts, default false, persisted like webSearchEnabled, initialized in the store default and every test reset. On send, pass the flag into the send path so the request sets the think param when ON (matching the backend request-flag decision).

FRONTEND render: In frontend/src/features/chat/MessageBubble.tsx, when a message has non-empty thinking text, render a COLLAPSIBLE, visually-distinct 'Reasoning' section ABOVE the answer body (use a <details>/<summary> or a button-toggled block; harbor-blue themed, distinct from the answer). Render nothing when thinking is absent/empty (no empty section, no crash). Add the styles to frontend/src/styles/app.css using existing tokens.

TESTS: (a) providers: a parse_stream_chunk test that a chunk carrying reasoning_content yields a ChatDelta with thinking set and content path intact; ChatDelta serde round-trip incl thinking. (b) core: events serde round-trip for the new variant + updated exhaustive secret-audit match. (c) frontend: a streamed thinking delta renders a collapsible Reasoning block when the message has thinking and none when absent; the toggle persists in the store (setThinkingEnabled true reflected); conversations store reducer appends thinking. Every test mounting <App/>/chat mocks invoke for ALL commands with well-formed shapes and initializes the new thinkingEnabled store field in resets.

Run the offline self-audit: per-crate cargo fmt --check (providers, orchestrator-core, tauri-app if touched); whole-frontend `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .`; static review for clippy/eslint/tsc classes and mock/field completeness. Record verified-live vs CI-only in findings.
acceptance_criteria: ChatDelta has an additive optional `thinking` field (default + skip_serializing_if); parse_stream_chunk captures reasoning_content/thinking and still yields thinking-only deltas.
A CoreEvent carries thinking to the frontend (new messageThinkingDelta variant or additive field), with camelCase serde and the secret-audit exhaustive match updated.
The composer has an OFF-by-default '🧠 Thinking' ON/OFF toggle (aria-pressed) backed by a persisted store flag, following the web-search toggle pattern.
When a message has thinking text, MessageBubble renders a collapsible, visually-distinct Reasoning section above the answer; when absent, nothing renders and no crash occurs.
Tests cover: delta parse with thinking, ChatDelta+event serde round-trip, collapsible renders when ON and not when absent, and toggle persistence.
The existing content/delta path is byte-identical when thinking is absent (no regression to v0.8.x chat).
verification: Run `cargo test --manifest-path crates/providers/Cargo.toml` and `--manifest-path crates/orchestrator-core/Cargo.toml` and confirm the new thinking tests pass (or record CI-only).
From hybrid-orchestrator/frontend run `npm test` and confirm the thinking toggle + reasoning-render + reducer tests pass; `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` clean (or CI-only).
Static-confirm the content delta path and persisted history are unchanged when thinking is absent.
findings: THINKING-CAPTURE MECHANISM: Parsed the OpenAI-compat streaming delta's reasoning key by adding `reasoning: Option<String>` to the private `StreamDelta` in crates/providers/src/adapters/native.rs with `#[serde(default, alias = "reasoning_content", alias = "thinking", alias = "reasoning")]` (Ollama's /v1 path emits `reasoning_content`; the two extra aliases cover other servers). parse_stream_chunk maps it into a NEW `ChatDelta.thinking: Option<String>` (crates/providers/src/contract.rs) with `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]` mirroring `content`. The empty-delta skip now also checks `thinking.is_none()` so a delta carrying ONLY thinking is still yielded. REQUEST-SIDE `think` PARAM: DEFERRED (capture-only), per FEAT-003 scoping guidance. Threading a request flag end-to-end balloons through run_turn's signature -> send_message command -> generate_handler -> IPC wrapper -> TS type, and thinking models over the OpenAI-compat /v1 path emit `reasoning_content` by default when they reason, so capture-only fully demonstrates the feature. NativeAdapter::body already splices `extra` to top-level, so a future request flag can ride `ChatRequest.extra` (e.g. `think: true`) with NO adapter change; the toggle currently gates DISPLAY (OFF by default) rather than the request. COREEVENT DESIGN: Added a NEW variant `MessageThinkingDelta { conversation_id, message_id, delta }` (rename_all camelCase) rather than an additive field on MessageDelta, keeping the content-delta path byte-identical. Updated the events doc header (twelve->thirteen), the exhaustive `no_core_event_variant_carries_secret_material` match + its `events` array, and added a `message_thinking_delta_round_trips_camel_case` serde test. The tauri-app event bridge (events.rs) forwards verbatim, so NO bridge change was needed. PERSISTENCE: Thinking is EVENT-ONLY, NOT persisted into the assistant message content. pipeline.rs::stream_turn emits MessageThinkingDelta from `delta.thinking` but does NOT push it into `outcome.content`, so history stays answer-only and the persisted `complete_message` text is the answer alone. Frontend accumulates it onto a FRONTEND-ONLY `Message.thinking` field (never sent back / never in the Rust DTO). FRONTEND: Added `thinkingEnabled` store flag + `setThinkingEnabled` (default false, initialized in the store default and every setState reset across chat/app/model-selector/history/conversations tests), a `messageThinkingDelta` reducer case appending to the message's `thinking` buffer (guarded on active conversation like messageDelta), a compact '🧠 Thinking' ON/OFF toggle in Composer's control row next to web-search (aria-pressed, aria-label 'Toggle reasoning trace', title 'Thinking: on'/'off', data-active), and a collapsible <details>/<summary> 'Reasoning' section in MessageBubble rendered ABOVE the answer, GATED on `thinkingEnabled && thinking.length>0` (so OFF-by-default truly hides it; nothing renders/crashes when absent). Harbor-blue-themed styles added to app.css using existing accent tokens (light+dark). VERIFIED LIVE: `cargo fmt --check` clean for crates/providers and crates/orchestrator-core (parses + formats). CI-ONLY (could not run in sandbox): `cargo test`/`cargo build`/clippy for providers + orchestrator-core FAIL to run here because the toolchain is rustc 1.92 and transitive AWS SDK deps (via the bedrock adapter) require rustc >= 1.94 and crates.io access (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY blocks the registry) - same class of constraint FEAT-002 recorded for tauri-app; the new Rust unit tests (native reasoning-capture x2, ChatDelta thinking round-trip, MessageThinkingDelta serde, updated secret-audit match, and a new streaming pipeline_e2e test `streamed_thinking_emits_thinking_delta_and_keeps_answer_only`) were self-audited statically. Also CI-ONLY: ALL frontend gates (vitest, tsc, eslint, prettier) - the sandbox has NO node/npm/npx and no node_modules, so `npm test` and `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` cannot run; frontend edits were self-audited for tsc-strict shape, no-unused-vars, prettier print-width 100 / trailingComma all / 2-space (long lines verified, multi-line apply() reflowed), CoreEvent union + Message.thinking mirrored in types/index.ts, and thinkingEnabled initialized in every store reset. No new Tauri command was added (feature needs none). Content/delta path is byte-identical when thinking is absent (thinking omitted from wire via skip_serializing_if; no thinking event emitted; no Reasoning section renders).
